mapper.select: SELECT fa.UNIT_ID FROM sys_user s, sys_user_allocation a, fnd_employee e, fnd_employee_assigns fa WHERE s.user_id = a.user_id AND a.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fa.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID AND fa.primary_position_flag = 'Y' AND a.ALLOCATION_ID = #{nextApprovePerson}

SELECT p.POSITION_ID
FROM FND_ORG_POSITION p LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit u ON p.unit_id = u.unit_id LEFT JOIN FND_COMPANY c ON u.company_id = c.company_id where p.unit_id=#{unitId} and p.CHIEF_POSITION_FLAG='Y'

SELECT e.employee_code AS employee_code FROM fnd_employee_assigns em LEFT JOIN FND_COMPANY c ON em.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN fnd_employee e ON em.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_POSITION p ON em.position_id = p.position_id LEFT JOIN fnd_org_unit u ON em.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE em.position_id = #{positionId}
